scientific_question: Does exposing the winning raw dynamic-medial model to the complete 4096-row training corpus improve longitudinal probability separation without changing its anti-blob behavior?

single_axis.rule: Start again from the released M7 checkpoint and change only total training duration. Dynamic-medial weight 0.03125, corpus, sample order, objective, optimizer, learning rate, batch, accumulation, trust radius, validation cadence, threshold band, and raw no-blend inference remain fixed.

candidate.label: dynconn_w0p03125_n4096_duration
candidate.hypothesis: The 1024-sample pilot saw only one quarter of the corpus and 99 scheduled event-bearing rows. A complete deterministic corpus pass should expose the remaining training geometry and sharpen valid-strip confidence before any loss or architecture change is justified.
